titles.native: サグラレ堕メ THE ANIMATION

description:
Yuzuki worked in massage parlor already for 1 year. Because she's getting married next month she stops working and wants to focus on her new family life. After stopping to work, Yuzuki begins to enjoy his new life married to his long-time sweetheart. However, busy work of the husband for Yuzuki and little one just have a little time for romance. Until the time the husband introduced his senior office employee to Yuzuki who had once been a loyal customer at a massage parlor where first. And what will happen in the future of Yuzuki's life?

(Source: Nekopoi and Has Been Translated and Edited)
